output.summary: An annual or short-lived perennial flowering plant of cultivated, probably hybrid origin. Its nearly circular leaves shed rain as rolling droplets, while its yellow, orange or red flowers are mildly scented. All above-ground parts are edible; the peppery flowers are used in salads and stir-fries, and unripe seed pods are pickled.
output.edibilityNote: All above-ground parts are edible; flowers are eaten in salads or stir-fries, and unripe seed pods are pickled as a caper substitute.
